topics.label: Lecture introduction and learning outcomes
topics.groupedBecause: This subtopic provides the administrative opening, framing, and learning outcomes for the lecture.

topics.label: Genetic and epigenetic mechanisms of clonal evolution
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics describe how cells acquire selective growth advantages and undergo clonal expansion through mutational accumulation and epigenetic alterations.

topics.label: Stem cell hierarchies and cell of origin in cancer
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics explore how normal tissue differentiation hierarchies and stemness properties determine the cell types capable of initiating and propagating tumors.

topics.label: Microenvironmental signals and inflammation in tumor progression
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics examine how external promotional stimuli, inflammatory pathways, and non-malignant stromal cells create permissive conditions for tumor outgrowth.

topics.label: Experimental and computational methods for studying tumor evolution
topics.groupedBecause: This subtopic explores the laboratory techniques, sequencing technologies, and computational approaches used to investigate tumor heterogeneity and evolution.

topics.label: Multifactorial synthesis of cancer evolution
topics.groupedBecause: This subtopic integrates the mutational, cellular, and microenvironmental determinants into a unified evolutionary model of cancer progression.

topics.label: Lecture conclusion and next session preview
topics.groupedBecause: This subtopic contains the concluding remarks and a preview of the subsequent lecture topic.
